meta.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
meta.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills — set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

copy.tagline: 初始化工程技能仓库的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在工程技能仓库中设置议题跟踪器和标签体系。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up issue tracker and label vocabulary for engineering skills.

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你配置仓库的议题追踪器、分类标签和领域文档布局，让其他工程技能能正常工作。它会先探索当前仓库状态，然后引导你一步步做出选择，最后写入配置文件。
howto.when: 首次使用其他工程技能（如 to-issues、triage、to-prd、qa）之前运行一次。

say.text: 帮我设置这个仓库的工程技能配置。
say.note: 技能会开始探索仓库并引导你完成设置。

say.text: 我想把议题追踪器改成本地 Markdown。
say.note: 技能会更新配置，让后续技能使用本地文件追踪议题。

howto.what_en: This skill configures the repo's issue tracker, triage labels, and domain doc layout so other engineering skills can work. It explores the current state, guides you through choices, and writes configuration files.
howto.when_en: Run once before first use of other engineering skills like to-issues, triage, to-prd, or qa.

say_en.text: Set up this repo for engineering skills.
say_en.note: The skill will explore and guide you through setup.

say_en.text: Switch the issue tracker to local markdown.
say_en.note: The skill will update config for local file-based issues.
